President Murmu Awards Teachers on National Teachers' Day

On Teachers' Day 2026, President Droupadi Murmu participated in a national ceremony honoring teachers across India. She conferred national awards to a group of educators, with reports varying on the number of awardees - some outlets said 82 exceptional educators, while another reported 21 higher‑education and polytechnic teachers. In her remarks, Murmu described teachers as “frontline nation‑builders” and urged them to nurture curiosity, confidence and sensitivity among students. She also called on teachers to update their skills and embrace technology in education. The President’s statements were presented in written messages and speeches emphasizing respect for teachers and the importance of modernising teaching methods.
